The '''Black Venom Sea''' was a region of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] in the [[Tatoo system/Legends|Tatoo system]] inhabited by the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]].

==History==
The potent pursuer of illegitimate activities, the Black Suns, coursed through the veins of the Black Venom Sea, dominating the area with heavy laser fire and lethal missiles. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the Black Suns hid behind [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine's]] shadow, waiting for the perfect time to strike with deadly precision and claim Tatooine's [[Star system/Legends|system]] as their own.
